# Qidrix

> Industrial innovation integrator: industrial radio networks, SCADA, telemetry, open-pit mine dispatching and AI analytics for mining, energy and agriculture.

Qidrix designs and delivers turnkey industrial digitalization projects in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan:
from radio links, base stations and onboard hardware to SCADA, telemetry, dispatching software and AI analytics.
Languages: Russian (default), English, Kazakh, Uzbek.

## Case studies

- [Digital Mine: Mining Fleet Digitization — Case Study](https://qidrix.asia/en/digimine/): Qidrix case study: open-pit radio network and repeaters, fail-safe power cabinets, onboard computers and V2X antennas on haul trucks, telemetry and mining fleet dispatching.
- [6/10 kV SCADA for the Karaganda Power Grid — Case](https://qidrix.asia/en/astra/): How Qidrix and Astrawireless built a wireless SCADA and telemetry network for Karaganda Zharyk: 30 base stations, 1,847 subscriber stations, 15 grid districts. Interactive 3D fly-over.
- [Digital Farming: Fleet Telemetry & Fuel Control — Case](https://qidrix.asia/en/agro/): Qidrix case study: field connectivity, tractor and combine telemetry, automated fuel accounting, video monitoring and drones for an agricultural enterprise. Turnkey delivery.
